# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidySingleCellExperiment)
library(MoleculeExperiment)
library(cytomapper)
library(SpatialExperiment)

library(sf)
library(raster)
library(terra)
library(cytomapper)
library(lisaClust)
library(simpleSeg)
library(FuseSOM)

library(scater)
library(Banksy)
library(scran)
library(igraph)

select = dplyr::select
```

# Reading data

```{r}
# Xenium images
xenium_image = MoleculeExperiment::readXenium("/dskh/nobackup/biostat/datasets/ruth_xenium_melanoma/output-XETG00179__0027870__Region_4__20240307__072513/")


# IMC images
imc_image = terra::rast("/dskh/nobackup/biostat/datasets/ruth_xenium_melanoma/IMC_70_4_aligned/RegisteredIMC_E8_20250717_ED.tif")

imcChannels = read_csv("/dskh/nobackup/biostat/datasets/ruth_xenium_melanoma/IMC_70_4_aligned/Channels.csv") |> 
  mutate(Marker = ifelse(grepl("_", Marker), sub(".*_(.*)", "\\1", Marker), Marker))

# remove nonsense channels
imc_image = imc_image[[1:47]] 


names(imc_image) = imcChannels$Marker


# Image Coordinates
imageCoords = readxl::read_xlsx("/dskh/nobackup/biostat/datasets/ruth_xenium_melanoma/imageCoords.xlsx") |> 
  filter(Slide == "70_4") # filtering to slide 70_4 for now
```

# Prepping imc images

## Converting Xenium transcript coordinates to Dapi coordinates.

```{r}
# found in the experiment.xenium file.
# Convert xenium transcript coords to dapi coords
xeniumScaleFactor = 0.2125

E8_coords = imageCoords |> 
    dplyr::filter(ImageID == "E8")

imcY = ext(imc_image)$ymax
imcX = ext(imc_image)$xmax

xmin = E8_coords$xmin / xeniumScaleFactor
xmax = E8_coords$xmax / xeniumScaleFactor

# Flip imc image upside down
ymin = E8_coords$ymin / xeniumScaleFactor
ymax = E8_coords$ymax / xeniumScaleFactor

# Crop E8 Image
E8_extent = terra::ext(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)

E8_raster = terra::crop(imc_image, y = E8_extent)

# Convert to EBImage
E8_array = as.array(E8_raster)

E8_image = EBImage::Image(E8_array)

#saveRDS(E8_image, "E8_raw/E8_raw_image.rds")
```


## E8 Molecule experiment object

```{r}
E8_coords = imageCoords |> 
  dplyr::filter(ImageID == "E8")
  
subset_extent = c(
  xmin = E8_coords$xmin,
  xmax = E8_coords$xmax,
  ymin = E8_coords$ymin,
  ymax = E8_coords$ymax
)

E8_me = subset_by_extent(xenium_image, subset_extent)

names(E8_me@molecules$detected) = "E8"
names(E8_me@boundaries$cell) = "E8"

# Rename cell ids
names(E8_me@boundaries$cell[["E8"]]) = 1:length(names(E8_me@boundaries$cell[["E8"]]))
```


## E8 mask
```{r}
boundries_list = E8_me@boundaries$cell[["E8"]]


# Convert boundries to polygons
polygons = lapply(boundries_list, function(df) {
  mat = as.matrix(df)
  return(st_polygon(list(mat)))
})

polygon_data = st_sf(cell_name = as.numeric(names(boundries_list)), geometry = polygons)

raster_extent = raster::extent(subset_extent)

# Create raster image
rasterLayer = raster(raster_extent, res = 1) 
rasterImage = fasterize::fasterize(polygon_data, rasterLayer, field = "cell_name") 

# Convert image to EBImage
labelMat = as.matrix(rasterImage)
labelMat[is.na(labelMat)] = 0  
E8_mask = Image(labelMat, colormode = "Grayscale")


```

# Creating SCE objects


## Xenium

```{r}

E8_xenium = MoleculeExperiment::countMolecules(E8_me)

# Avoids conflict with ME and tidySingleCellExperiment
E8_xenium$x_location = NULL
E8_xenium$y_location = NULL

E8_xenium = E8_xenium |> 
  mutate(imageCellID = sub(".*\\.", "", cell_id))
```

```{r}
E8_imc_sce <- cytomapper::measureObjects(
  E8Mask_cyto,
  E8_cyto,
  img_id = "imageID",
  return_as = "sce",
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 30))


E8_imc_sce = E8_imc_sce |> 
  dplyr::rename(
    "x" = "m.cx",
    "y"= "m.cy",
    "imageCellID" = "object_id") |> 
  select(.cell, imageID, imageCellID, x, y)


colnames(E8_imc_sce) = paste("E8", colnames(E8_imc_sce), sep = ".")

names(assays(E8_imc_sce)) = "protein_intensities"


E8_xenium <- SingleCellExperiment(
  colData = colData(E8_imc_sce),
  assays = list(transcript_counts = assay(E8_xenium, "counts")[, colnames(E8_imc_sce)]))

#saveRDS(E8_imc_sce, "rds_data/E8_imc.rds")
#saveRDS(E8_xenium, "rds_data/E8_xenium.rds")
```


# Cell Typing


## IMC 
```{r}
E8_imc = readRDS("rds_data/E8_imc.rds")


clusterMarkers = c(
  "CD11c",
  # "CD16", # Myeloid marker
  "CD68",
  #"panCK", # Epithelial cells, not really expected in E8
  "CD20",
  "CD8a",
  "podoplanin",
  "CD14",
  "FX111A",
  # "FoxP3", # CD4 transcript marker, not very highly expressed
  "CD45",
  "CD66a",
  "CD3",
  "anti-cy5", #SOX10 tumour marker
  "HLADR",
  "CD4",
  # "CD56",
  "CD31"
)


useMarkers = rownames(E8_imc)[!(rownames(E8_imc) %in% c("80ArAr", "104Pd", "HH3", "189Os", "190Os", "DNA1", "DNA2", "208Pb"))]
```

```{r}
E8_imc <- FuseSOM::estimateNumCluster(E8_imc, kSeq = 2:30)
FuseSOM::optiPlot(E8_imc, method = "gap")
```

```{r }

# Transform and normalise the marker expression of each cell type.
E8_imc <- normalizeCells(E8_imc,
                        markers = useMarkers,
                        transformation = NULL, # either asinh or sqrt
                        method = c( "PC1",  "trim99", "minMax"),
                        assayIn = "protein_intensities",
                        cores = 10)


E8_imc |> 
  join_features(features = useMarkers, shape = "long", assay = "protein_intensities") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = .abundance_protein_intensities)) + 
  geom_density() + 
  facet_wrap(~.feature) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme_classic()

E8_imc |> 
  join_features(features = useMarkers, shape = "long", assay = "norm") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = .abundance_norm)) + 
  geom_density() + 
  facet_wrap(~.feature) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme_classic()


# Set seed.
set.seed(51773)

# Generate SOM and cluster cells into 10 groups
E8_imc <- FuseSOM::runFuseSOM(
  E8_imc,
  markers = clusterMarkers,
  assay = "norm",
  numClusters = 10
)


scater::plotGroupedHeatmap(
  E8_imc,
  features = clusterMarkers,
  group = "clusters",
  exprs_values = "norm",
  
  center = TRUE,
  scale = TRUE,
  zlim = c(-3, 3),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  block = "clusters"
) 


```

```{r}

E8_imc |> 
  join_features(rownames(E8_imc), shape = "wide", assay = "protein_intensities") |>

E8_imc |>

E8_imc |>

  arrange(DNA1) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, col = DNA1)) +

```

## Xenium 


```{r}
E8_xenium = readRDS("rds_data/E8_xenium.rds")

# There are 119 cells with no trancripts
table(colSums(assay(E8_xenium)) == 0)

zeroCells = names(which(colSums(assay(E8_xenium)) == 0))


E8_xenium = E8_xenium |> 
  filter(!(.cell %in% zeroCells))

E8_xenium = scater::logNormCounts(E8_xenium, assay.type = "transcript_counts")


pattern <- "^(NegControlCodeword|NegControlProbe|UnassignedCodeword)"
neg_idx <- grepl(pattern, rownames(E8_xenium))

E8_xenium_no_negative = E8_xenium[!neg_idx, ]
```

```{r}


E8_xenium_spe = SpatialExperiment(
  assays = assays(E8_xenium_no_negative),        
  rowData = rowData(E8_xenium_no_negative),       
  colData = colData(E8_xenium_no_negative),       
  spatialCoords = as.matrix(select(E8_xenium_no_negative, x, y))
)


set.seed(51773)

clusters = clustSIGNAL::clustSIGNAL(E8_xenium_spe, "imageID", outputs = "c")


E8_xenium_no_negative = E8_xenium_no_negative |> 
  left_join(clusters$clusters, join_by(".cell" == "Cells"))



plot = scater::plotGroupedHeatmap(
  E8_xenium_no_negative,
  features = rownames(E8_xenium_no_negative),
  group = "Clusters",
  exprs_values = "logcounts",
  center = TRUE,
  scale = TRUE,
  zlim = c(-3, 3),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  block = "Clusters",
  fontsize_row  = 8
) 

ggsave("clustSIGNAL_heatmap.pdf", plot, height = 40, width = 5)


E8_xenium_no_negative |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y =y, col = Clusters)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.4) +
  theme_classic()

E8_xenium_no_negative$Clusters |> table()

```


```{r}

mgs = findMarkers(E8_xenium_no_negative, groups=E8_xenium_no_negative$Clusters, direction="up", assay.type = "logcounts")
# select for a few markers per cluster
top <- lapply(mgs, \(df) rownames(df)[df$Top <= 5])
top


```



```{r}
set.seed(51773)

E8_xenium_no_negative = scater::runPCA(E8_xenium_no_negative)

E8_xenium_no_negative = scater::runUMAP(E8_xenium_no_negative)

scater::plotReducedDim(E8_xenium_no_negative, dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "Clusters")
```
